svg.title: Bluebikes data, event review, crew planning and held-out evaluation
svg.desc: Python builds station-hour inventory proxies from historical trips and current station metadata, then freezes a 2026 forecast trained on 2024 and 2025. OpenAI extracts structured event facts using a versioned prompt. Python validates them and a human confirms them. Only an explicit user demand assumption and Apply action connect reviewed event facts to Python crew optimization. January through September 2026 trips are used only for held-out backtesting, with no feedback to training.
